title: [Control systems] Schneider Electric security advisory (AV26-1051)
description: As of October 13, 2026, Schneider Electric is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Sage RTU 1410/1430/1450
	Versions prior to C3414-500-S02L0

Sage RTU 2400
	Versions prior to C3414-500-S02L0

Sage RTU 3030 Magnum
	Versions prior to C3414-500-S02L0

Sage RTU 4400
	Versions prior to C3414-500-S02L0
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
